title_zh: Arts and crafts — 第28节可背诵讲义
body_en: Visit an art show or watch a hand-work video, then try a small copy at home. Write five English words for colours, shapes, and tools you used. Show your work and explain one hard step you solved. Practice turns mistakes into skill.
body_zh: 参观艺术展或看手工视频，然后在家试做一个小作品。写下五个英语词：你用到的颜色、形状和工具。展示作品并解释你解决的一个难点。练习把错误变成技能。
